title: An Act amending the act of December 22, 1983 (P.L.306, No.84), known as the Board of Vehicles Act, in preliminary provisions, further providing for definitions; in vehicles, further providing for grounds for disciplinary proceedings, repealing provisions relating to recreational vehicle shows, recreational vehicle off-premise sales, recreational vehicle exhibitions and recreational vehicle rallies and to off-premise sales, shows, exhibitions or rallies on Sundays; and, in recreational vehicles, further providing for written agreements and designated territories, for termination, cancellation, nonrenewal and alteration of dealership by manufacturer, for termination, cancellation, nonrenewal and alteration of dealership by dealer, for repurchase of inventory, for transfer of dealership and family succession, for warranty obligations, for indemnification and for coercion of dealer prohibited and providing for recreational vehicle events and for recreational vehicle events on Sundays.

actions.description: Referred to Consumer Protection & Professional Licensure
